title: The Small Part in the Lantern Walk
youtube_title: The Small Part in the Lantern Walk | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice used at the right moment.
summary: At a small school room with a low stage edge, Milo feels shy about a small spoken part in the lantern walk. Instead of pretending not to care, Milo tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Mama stays kind and does not push for a show.
